sentence: This project designs quantum circuits and simulations for signal processing and machine learning, including audio recognition and image understanding.
This project assesses the potential of a miniaturized laboratory system that automates tissue culture experiments using microfluidics, imaging and electrophysiology.
This project builds a phone tool that uses computer vision to add diagrams and simulations to photos of everyday objects, showing the science behind them.
This project builds a way to combine data from repair steps into knowledge graphs to improve hybrid remanufacturing that uses additive manufacturing and machining.
This project studies whether magnetic fields are common in disks of dust and gas where planets form, and whether they affect how planets form.
This project builds a robot system with flying and ground robots that clears leaves and branches so robots can find and pick apples in orchards.
This project builds a model of how saltwater moves into coastal volcanic aquifers, including the conduit flow process.
This project tries to find out why symbolic execution lacks adoption and builds a framework that helps find vulnerabilities in software.
This project builds algorithms that detect changes in how people make decisions over social networks and studies how the glass-ceiling effect arises.
This project studies how often, when and why people prove their identity with passwords and other tools, and what problems they face doing so.
This project builds a flood early warning system that combines deep learning with physical modeling to predict floods in farming watersheds.
This project builds a framework that combines symbolic reasoning with hyperdimensional computing to transfer learned knowledge from simulated environments to real-world environments.
This project builds modular quantum computers by linking multi-qubit nodes with quantum interconnects.
This project builds a robotic surgical manipulator that combines human power with computer control and tests it with surgeons in a simulated surgical environment.
This project studies how eye size in Daphnia affects vision, the costs of vision, and fitness in different environments.
This project studies how a coordinator can learn from information that participants share and design incentives that steer large groups toward better outcomes.
